title: Split large-index status and definition inspection into bounded commands
trigger_preconditions: a repository has a large inherited index
failure_signature: A combined Git status plus definition import exceeded the twenty-second command bound and returned exit 124.
candidate_workaround: Decompose large-index repository checks from verbose data inspection and give each one a measured bounded lifetime.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine Git status with Python imports or verbose portfolio output in the same short-lived wrapper.
rollback: Retain the timeout and stop rather than raising the bound repeatedly without decomposition.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
